editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood breakfast spot where generous portions, authentic flavors, and genuinely kind staff create an atmosphere that turns first-time visitors into devoted regulars.
editorial.insiderTip: Skip reservations—just check in with the hostess, give your number, and you'll get a text when your table is ready; even on busy holiday mornings, waits are surprisingly short.

topDishes.note: So beloved kids request birthday parties here just to eat them again
